asset : asset.src } const SHIPPING = 4 const TAX = 4 type CartItem = { id: number name: string image: string alt: string size: string color: string price: number originalPrice: number quantity: number } const INITIAL_ITEMS: CartItem[] = [ { id: 1, name: "Sweater", image: assetSrc(tee1Img), alt: "Sweater", size: "MD", color: "Black", price: 18.5, originalPrice: 22.5, quantity: 1, }, { id: 2, name: "Flat Sweater", image: assetSrc(tee2Img), alt: "Flat sweater", size: "LG", color: "Black", price: 12, originalPrice: 18, quantity: 1, }, { id: 3, name: "Lightweight T-Shirt", image: assetSrc(tee3Img), alt: "Lightweight t-shirt", size: "XL", color: "Dark green", price: 14, originalPrice: 20, quantity: 1, }, { id: 4, name: "Jacket", image: assetSrc(tee4Img), alt: "Jacket", size: "MD", color: "Green", price: 11.5, originalPrice: 16.5, quantity: 1, }, ] function savingsPct(price: number, original: number) { return Math.round(((original - price) / original) * 100) } export default function ShoppingCart({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { const baseId = React.useId() const [cartItems, setCartItems] = React.useState(INITIAL_ITEMS) const [promoCode, setPromoCode] = React.useState("") const [wishlisted, setWishlisted] = React.useState([]) const subtotal = cartItems.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.quantity, 0) const compareTotal = cartItems.reduce( (s, i) => s + i.originalPrice * i.quantity, 0 ) const saved = compareTotal - subtotal const total = subtotal + SHIPPING + TAX return (
